corrections_applied.issue: evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md were injected unconditionally into baseSystemInstruction for all steps (Steps 0, 1, 2, 4) where they are not authorized.
corrections_applied.change: Removed evaluation documents from baseSystemInstruction so that default system instructions contain only Agents.md. In Step 3, both the executor and supervisor prompts and system instructions explicitly incorporate the complete text of evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md to satisfy lines 297-300 and lines 752-755.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md lines 297-300 ('Before Step 3.A or any other Step 3 execution action, the executor must read evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md completely and use both documents as evaluation context throughout Step 3.') and lines 752-755 ('Before any other Step 3 supervisory action, the supervisor must read evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md completely and use both documents as evaluation context for the Step 3 Supervisory Gate.').

corrections_applied.issue: Step 3 internal repetition loop was omitted; candidate schemas with Loop_Decision === 'True' or step_3_completed !== true were passed directly to the supervisory gate without returning to Step 3.A.
corrections_applied.change: Added an internal execution loop in requestExecutionSchema for Step 3: if Step_3.G.Loop_Decision is 'True' or Step_3.G.return_to is 'Step_3.A', the runtime rejects the current plan P and prompts the model to return to Step 3.A with feedback until Loop_Decision is 'False' and step_3_completed is true.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md lines 387-414 (Step 3.G 'If Loop_Decision is True, reject the current P and return to Step 3.A. If Loop_Decision is False, do not return and permit Step 3 to complete.', 'step_3_completed: Set to true only when Loop_Decision is False and the current P has passed all Step3_TSR tests.').

corrections_applied.issue: ensureProcedureState allowed arbitrary resumption and initialization bypassing Step 0 sequential start.
corrections_applied.change: Enforced strict sequential execution starting at Step 0, resetting current_step to 0 if uninitialized or invalid, and ensuring completed_steps and remaining_steps maintain canonical ascending order.

unresolved_requirements: External persistent storage (e.g. Google Drive/Google Sheets) and UI output display bindings specified in Step 0 (lines 107-110), Step 1 (lines 170-177), Step 2 (lines 230-232), and Step 4 (lines 926-928) cannot be executed directly beyond recording to local disk repository files (statePath and messagesPath) without inventing an unspecified external Google Drive / Sheets API credentials interface.
